notes: Public AI news with emphasis on free / open-weight releases, free API tiers, frontier launches, and viral indie builds. Summaries are short; follow url. Never treat as investment advice. Prefer official pages.

items.title: Z.AI lists GLM-4.7-Flash / GLM-4.5-Flash API as Free
items.title_zh: Z.AI 价表：GLM-4.7-Flash / 4.5-Flash API 免费
items.summary: Current Z.AI developer pricing table marks GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Flash input/output/cache as Free (verify before relying on free tier).
items.summary_zh: Z.AI 官方价表将 GLM-4.7-Flash、GLM-4.5-Flash 的输入/输出/缓存标为 Free（使用前请再核验）。

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro live on Moonshot API platform
items.title_zh: 月之暗面 Kimi K3.1 Pro 上线 API
items.summary: Kimi API Platform highlights K3.1 Pro at $2/$10 per MTok (cache hit $0.20); moonshot-v1 family previously retired.
items.summary_zh: Kimi API 平台主推 K3.1 Pro（$2/$10 / MTok，缓存命中 $0.20）；旧 moonshot-v1 已下线。

items.title: Gemini Developer API still offers a free tier
items.title_zh: Gemini 开发者 API 仍提供免费档
items.summary: Google AI for Developers pricing page: Free tier includes limited model access and free input/output tokens via AI Studio (content may improve Google products). Check live limits in your project.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌开发者价表：免费档含有限模型与免费输入/输出（AI Studio；内容可能用于改进产品）。具体限额以项目控制台为准。

items.title: OpenAI: cyber pipeline finds/patches 948 Linux LPEs (~$1.2M API)
items.title_zh: OpenAI：网络攻防流水线发现/修补 948 个 Linux 提权漏洞（约 $120 万 API）
items.summary: Nov 4 OpenAI research post: an upcoming cyber model pipeline dynamically reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel findings and produced 948 working local privilege-escalation exploits plus candidate patches (mid-Oct run; ~$1.21M API credits). Human review + Patch the Planet reporting.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 11/4 研究博文：即将发布的 cyber 模型流水线动态复现 1,724 个 Linux 内核发现，并产出 948 个可用本地提权利用与候选补丁（10 月中旬一轮，约 $121 万 API）。经人工审阅后走 Patch the Planet 上报。

items.title: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro open weights on Hugging Face
items.title_zh: 月之暗面在 Hugging Face 开源 Kimi K3.1 Pro 权重
items.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro (2.8T MoE, ~104B active, 1M context, multimodal) weights are live on HF as moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro under the Kimi K3.1 Pro License. MXFP4 weights / MXFP8 activations; API also on platform.kimi.ai.
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro（2.8T MoE、约 104B 激活、100 万上下文、多模态）权重已上线 HF（moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro），许可为 Kimi K3.1 Pro License。MXFP4 权重 / MXFP8 激活；API 见 platform.kimi.ai。

items.title: SambaNova Cloud free tier rate limits published
items.title_zh: SambaNova Cloud 公布免费档限额
items.summary: SambaNova docs: free tier roughly 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 200k tokens/day per model until a payment method is linked; preview models may be removed quickly.
items.summary_zh: SambaNova 文档：免费档大约每模型 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 每天 20 万 tokens（绑卡前）；预览模型可能随时下线。

items.title: OpenRouter :free models — 50 req/day (1k after $10)
items.title_zh: OpenRouter :free 模型：每天 50 次（充 $10 后 1000）
items.summary: Guides summarizing OpenRouter docs: model IDs ending in :free cost $0; shared caps ~20 RPM / 50 RPD, rising to 1,000 RPD after buying $10 credits. Rotating open models only.
items.summary_zh: 综合 OpenRouter 文档的指南：ID 以 :free 结尾的模型 $0；约 20 RPM / 50 RPD，累计充值 $10 后日限升至 1000。免费池为轮换开源模型。

items.title: Mistral Free plan: ~$10/mo API credits, no card
items.title_zh: Mistral 免费计划：约每月 $10 API 额度，可不绑卡
items.summary: Mistral pricing / free-API trackers: Free mode grants about $10 of monthly API credits with console rate limits; docs say no card required for Free.
items.summary_zh: Mistral 价表与免费 API 追踪：Free 模式约每月 $10 API 额度，限额在控制台查看；文档称 Free 可不绑卡。

items.title: Hugging Face Inference Providers: $0.10 free credit/mo
items.title_zh: HF Inference Providers：每月 $0.10 免费额度
items.summary: HF Inference Providers pricing: free accounts get about $0.10/mo credit (PRO $2); credits do not apply when you bring your own provider key.
items.summary_zh: HF Inference Providers 价表：免费账号约每月 $0.10 额度（PRO $2）；自带供应商 Key 时不计该额度。

items.title: Cohere trial keys: 1,000 API calls/month free
items.title_zh: Cohere 试用 Key：每月 1000 次免费调用
items.summary: Cohere rate-limit docs: trial keys get 1,000 API calls/month and ~20 RPM per chat model — evaluation only, not for production.
items.summary_zh: Cohere 限流文档：试用 Key 每月 1000 次、聊天约 20 RPM — 仅评估，不可用于生产。

items.title: Cloudflare Workers AI: 10,000 free Neurons/day
items.title_zh: Cloudflare Workers AI：每天 1 万免费 Neurons
items.summary: Cloudflare docs: Workers Free includes 10,000 Neurons/day; some frontier hosts (e.g. certain Kimi/GLM/DeepSeek) need Workers Paid. Text gen capped at 300 RPM.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 文档：Workers 免费档含每天 1 万 Neurons；部分前沿模型需 Workers Paid。文本生成全计划 300 RPM 上限。

items.title: Alibaba Model Studio: new-user free token quota
items.title_zh: 阿里云百炼：新用户免费 Token 额度
items.summary: Alibaba Cloud help: international Model Studio typically grants ~1M tokens per model (in+out) for 90 days after activation for Qwen in Singapore region — enable Free Quota Only to avoid overage.
items.summary_zh: 阿里云帮助文档：国际站 Model Studio 新用户常见为每模型约 100 万 tokens（输入+输出）90 天有效（新加坡区通义）；建议打开仅用免费额度以免超额计费。

items.title: Qwen restates open-weight commitment; Max stays closed
items.title_zh: 通义重申开源承诺，Max 仍闭源 API
items.summary: Coverage of Alibaba/Qwen’s open-weight stats and that Max-tier models remain API-only while smaller tiers stay downloadable.
items.summary_zh: 报道梳理通义开源数据与承诺：Max 档仍为 API-only，较小档位继续开源权重。

items.title: Meituan unveils LongCat-2.5 (1.6T MoE) on domestic chips
items.title_zh: 美团发布 LongCat-2.5（1.6T MoE，国产芯片训成）
items.summary: Caixin (Nov 3): Meituan launched LongCat-2.5 on Monday — a natively multimodal MoE with 1.6T total parameters for long-horizon agent tasks, trained entirely on homegrown accelerators. Aimed at internal merchant/workbench efficiency, not raw compute sales.
items.summary_zh: 财新（11/3）：美团周一发布 LongCat-2.5——原生多模态 MoE，总参 1.6T，面向长程 Agent 任务，全程国产加速卡训练。主要用于内部商家工作台提效，而非对外卖算力。

items.title: Google Meet: admin policy notice before AI note-taking
items.title_zh: Google Meet：管理员可在 AI 纪要前显示政策提示
items.summary: Google announced Workspace admins can show custom policy text in the Meet green room when a call is recorded, transcribed, or summarised by Gemini note-taking (rollout from ~Nov 2).
items.summary_zh: 谷歌宣布 Workspace 管理员可在 Meet 等候室显示自定义政策文案，用于 Gemini 录制/转写/纪要场景（约 11/2 起滚动发布）。

items.title: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve (provable inference)
items.title_zh: Anthropic 开源 FlashProve（可证明推理原型）
items.summary: Anthropic research post on provable inference; FlashProve is an Apache-2.0 prototype that can cryptographically attest a response came from committed model weights without revealing them.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布可证明推理研究，并开源 Apache-2.0 原型 FlashProve：可在不泄露权重的情况下证明回复来自已承诺模型。

items.title: Karpathy ships HackerTube (~2h with Claude Code)
items.title_zh: Karpathy 手搓上线 HackerTube（约 2 小时，Claude Code）
items.summary: Andrej Karpathy’s Oct 31 post: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) mined HN comments into a YouTube-style site of 6,454 videos recommended across ~40K comments (2007–2026). He did API key, VPS and domain by hand; live at hackertube.org.
items.summary_zh: Andrej Karpathy 10/31 博文：用 Claude Code（Opus 5.5）从 HN 评论筛出约 4 万条荐片评论，做成 6454 条视频的 YouTube 风格站（2007–2026）。本人只手工做了 YouTube API Key、VPS 与域名；站点 hackertube.org。

items.title: Groq free plan: gpt-oss + Qwen3.8 without a card
items.title_zh: Groq 免费档：gpt-oss 与 Qwen3.8，无需绑卡
items.summary: 2026 free-API roundups: Groq Free covers openai/gpt-oss-120b & 20b plus qwen/qwen3.8-27b (~30 RPM, 1k req/day, 200k tokens/day per model); no payment method required for Free.
items.summary_zh: 2026 免费 API 盘点：Groq Free 含 gpt-oss-120b/20b 与 Qwen3.8-27B（约 30 RPM、每天 1000 次、每模型 20 万 tokens）；免费档可不绑卡。

items.title: Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) open weights on Hugging Face
items.title_zh: Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）开源权重上线 Hugging Face
items.summary: Mistral released Large 4 (~1T MoE / ~52B active, multimodal, 1M context) weights in FP8 and NVFP4 under a modified MIT (Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight) license — free to use/fine-tune/commercialize; MaaS resale needs a separate commercial license. HF blog dated Oct 29; API ~$0.70/$2.10 per M tokens.
items.summary_zh: Mistral 放出 Large 4（约 1T MoE / ~52B 激活、多模态、100 万上下文）FP8 与 NVFP4 权重，许可为改良 MIT（Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight）：可自用/微调/商用，但做模型即服务需另购商用许可。HF 博文日期 10/29；API 约 $0.70/$2.10 每百万 token。

items.title: HF blog: run Mistral Large 4 (transformers / vLLM / llama.cpp)
items.title_zh: HF 博文：如何跑 Mistral Large 4（transformers / vLLM / llama.cpp）
items.summary: Hugging Face Oct 29 guide for Le Chonk day-0 support: Transformers, vLLM (NVFP4), llama.cpp/GGUF, Inference Endpoints, and TRL fine-tuning. Notes ~1T total / ~49–52B active and the MaaS license caveat.
items.summary_zh: Hugging Face 10/29 指南：Le Chonk 首日支持 Transformers、vLLM（NVFP4）、llama.cpp/GGUF、Inference Endpoints 与 TRL 微调。注明约 1T 总参 / ~49–52B 激活及 MaaS 许可限制。

items.title: Baidu Unlimited-OCR-2 open on HF (MIT)
items.title_zh: 百度 Unlimited-OCR-2 开源上线 HF（MIT）
items.summary: Open-weights trackers list baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2 (~3.3B, MIT) around Oct 26–30 — OCR-focused open model.
items.summary_zh: 开源权重追踪约 10/26–30 列出 baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2（约 3.3B，MIT）— 面向 OCR 的开源模型。

items.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B open under Apache 2.0 (HF)
items.title_zh: Nanbeige4.3-33B 以 Apache 2.0 开源（HF）
items.summary: MarkTechPost (Oct 25): Nanbeige LLM Lab (BOSS Zhipin) releases Nanbeige4.3-33B (+ Base) on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0; 33B dense, ~524k context, aimed at agentic coding/cowork.
items.summary_zh: MarkTechPost（10/25）：BOSS 直聘 Nanbeige 实验室在 HF 以 Apache 2.0 发布 Nanbeige4.3-33B（及 Base）；33B 稠密、约 52.4 万上下文，面向 agentic coding。
